extraction_notes: The characteristic plots are family-level S1A through S1M traces; the supplied plot does not isolate a trace uniquely for S1M, so no curve points were assigned to this order.
The 25 degC reverse-current table entry for S1M is 5 uA at its rated 1000 V blocking voltage.
omission_reason: The PDF contains family-level plots, but the target S1M trace is not uniquely separable from the grouped S1K/S1M or S1A-through-S1J traces.
